## Problem

Public request programs can break down when forms, locations, eligibility checks, scheduling, and field records are disconnected.

## Workflow

1. Resident request submitted
2. Address or site location validated
3. Eligibility and service-area checks completed
4. Appointment or route planned
5. Distribution recorded
6. Dashboard updated
7. Follow-up or reporting completed

## Spatial components

- Geocoding
- Service-area validation
- Pickup/delivery logistics
- Dashboard monitoring
- Request-density mapping
